title: On Asymptotic Covariance of Unrotated Factor Solutions
content: This paper derives closed-form expressions for the asymptotic covariance matrices of unrotated factor loading and uniqueness estimators for several widely used non-maximum-likelihood factor extraction methods. These include least squares, principal factor, iterative principal component, alpha factor, and image factor analysis. By expressing these results explicitly in terms of the asymptotic covariance of the sample covariance or correlation matrix, the proposed formulas facilitate straightforward computation of standard errors. When combined with the delta method from rotation criteria, they further yield analytically tractable standard errors for rotated factor loadings. Monte Carlo simulations demonstrate accurate finite-sample performance, and an empirical application illustrates practical implementation of the proposed approach.
